description:
The Huffy Tekton 27.5" Mountain Bike is designed for riders ready to push beyond the pavement. A durable frame and trail-ready design create a stable, confident ride whether you're exploring neighborhood paths or venturing onto light trails. Built for everyday adventure, Tekton delivers the strength and control riders need to keep moving forward.
A 21-speed Shimano drivetrain with easy-to-use twist shifting helps riders find the right gear for changing terrain. Climb hills, cruise flats, and maintain momentum with smooth, reliable shifting that keeps every ride feeling capable and controlled.
A front suspension fork helps absorb bumps and rough terrain while wide 27.5" x 2.4" tires provide extra grip and stability on dirt, gravel, and pavement. Combined with dependable linear pull brakes, the Tekton keeps every ride steady, controlled, and ready for the next trail.

components.description: Linear Pull Brakes: Responsive braking delivers dependable stopping power when the trail turns or the ride speeds up.
Wide 2.4" tires provide strong grip and stability across dirt, gravel, and neighborhood roads.
